detail.longDescription: I am looking to build a machine learning model (or a Google Colab notebook) that can automatically learn and predict the space and time complexity of code. To keep the initial scope manageable, I want to focus specifically on identifying and analyzing code 'hotspots' (the most resource-intensive parts of a program, like deeply nested loops or heavy memory allocations). I would love to get your input or ideas on how to approach this. Specifically: What are the best ways to represent the code as data for the model (e.g., Abstract Syntax Trees, control flow graphs, or tokenization)? Are there existing datasets or open-source tools available for training a model on code complexity? What machine learning or deep learning architectures would be best suited for analyzing these code hotspots?
